newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July crude palm oil output up 5.27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July crude palm oil output up 5.27 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 5.27 percent to 833,159 tonnes in July from 791,426 in June, and against 722,382 in July 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Friday.
July palm oil exports were 715,906 tonnes against 622,210 in June and 662,035 in July 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 5.42 percent to 638,975 tonnes in July from 606,099 in June and against 594,525 in July 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 4.78 percent to 194,184 tonnes in July from 185,327 in June and against 127,857 in July last year.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 4.09 percent to 105,151 tonnes in July from 101,015 in June and against 95,137 in July 1996.
